entries.english:
<Adventure tips>
There are plenty of pots, barrels and
other things to search above ground.
Some contain very valuable items.
Be sure to check them!
entries.notes: Independent translation from the pinned Japanese. Gameplay mechanics are specific to Torneko 3. Explicit English lines replace Japanese indentation; all controls and mechanics are retained.

entries.japanese: <冒険のヒント><CR>・$tが動けばモンスターも動くぞ！<CR>$x自分が動くまでモンスターも動かないので<CR>$xあせらずゆっくりと次の手を考えよう！<CR>・ダンジョンに入ったらすぐに装備をしよう！<CR>$xダンジョンに入った時は装備をしていないぞ。<CR>$x武器や盾、指輪などを持っていたら<CR>$xわすれずに装備しよう！

source_tokens.text: が動けばモンスターも動くぞ！
自分が動くまでモンスターも動かないので
あせらずゆっくりと次の手を考えよう！
・ダンジョンに入ったらすぐに装備をしよう！

entries.english:
<Dungeon tips>
Monsters move when $t moves.
They wait until you act, so take your
time and think about your next move!
You start a dungeon with nothing
equipped. If you have a weapon,
shield or ring, remember to equip it
as soon as you enter!

entries.english:
<Orders for allies>
You can only give orders to allied
monsters next to $t.
More orders become available as
$t's level increases.
To see the list of allied monsters,
choose Allies or press L.

entries.english:
<Moving several items>
You can put several items into a pot
or storage, or take them out at once.
R + A: Select an item for the group.
R + B: Deselect an item.
You can also use L instead of R to
select items for a group transfer.

entries.english:
<Speed: $t and monsters>
Normal: Move or attack once per turn.
Double speed, one attack:
Move twice per turn, but attacking
ends your turn.
Double speed, two attacks:
Move or attack twice per turn.
Slow: Move or attack once every
two turns.

<Full map>
Press SELECT to show the full map.
Press SELECT or B to return to play.

monsters and see items or stairs
underneath them.

change the map display or hide it
during play.
